normative_extracts.quote: Floats, absolutely positioned elements, block containers that are not block boxes, and block boxes with overflow other than visible establish new block formatting contexts.

browser_support.notes: display: flow-root is Baseline Widely Available; BFCs themselves date back to CSS 2.1.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Each BFC maintains its own float exclusion list and prevents vertical margins from collapsing across its boundary.

production_failures.symptom: Card container collapses to 0px height around a floated avatar image
production_failures.root_cause: Parent block box does not establish a BFC, so floated children are excluded from its auto height calculation.
production_failures.mitigation: Add display: flow-root to the parent container instead of legacy clearfix hacks.

production_failures.symptom: Top margin on an <h1> pushes down the entire parent section instead of creating internal padding
production_failures.root_cause: Adjacent parent and first-child vertical margins collapse through when no border, padding, or BFC separates them.
production_failures.mitigation: Use display: flow-root on the parent or use padding/gap on a flex/grid container.
